changes.bank_transfer: bank.jsonl, protocol.json, runner and parser are embedded in the private kernel script as a base64 tar.gz; the job verifies the bank sha256 before running. key.jsonl is not embedded. changes.cost: Kaggle free quota (GPU hours, no currency spend). GPU hours used are reported instead of USD.
changes.engine.dtype: float16 instead of bfloat16 (T4 has no bf16)
